presets.name: Envelope Cry Baby
presets.desc: A Cry Baby resonance swept by picking dynamics: each attack opens the wah, the decay closes it
presets.notes: Keeps golem's autowah block sound (GxAutoWah, Wah type); sensitivity a touch above default for typical DI levels

presets.name: Clavinet funk quack
presets.desc: Opto band-pass envelope filter on clavinet: every keystroke quacks upward, fast and percussive

refs.why: his Clavinet riff played through a Mu-Tron III

presets.notes: Crate's keys/clav start; Opto mimics the Mu-Tron's LED/LDR lag; +3 dB makes up the band-pass level loss

presets.name: Funk guitar envelope quack
presets.desc: Level-independent band-pass envelope filter: the same quack on muted funk strums at any volume
presets.notes: The crate's Mu-Tron III guitar start: band-pass, up, 250 Hz to 2.5 kHz, peak 5

presets.name: Watery jam-band lead
presets.desc: Band-pass with dry blended in and a lagging opto release: a liquid, vowel-like lead tone

refs.why: Jerry Garcia made the Mu-Tron III part of his lead sound

presets.notes: Crate's Garcia start (BP + dry, opto, release 250 ms): the dry keeps note definition under the vowel

presets.name: Squelchy space bass
presets.desc: Low-pass envelope filter on bass that squelches upward on each note while the sub stays dry

refs.why: used the Mu-Tron III on his bass with Parliament/Funkadelic

presets.notes: The crate's Bootsy start; bass keep 120 Hz (Linkwitz-Riley) keeps the bottom from thinning when the filter closes

presets.name: Synth-like 4-pole bass
presets.desc: Steep, resonant 4-pole low-pass opened by each note: bass that sounds like an analog mono synth
presets.notes: Crate's Moog-style start: 4 poles + peak 10 give the synth 'zap'; fast attack for slap and pick

presets.name: Downward 'ow' sweep
presets.desc: Envelope sweeps down on loud notes: each attack starts bright and falls into an 'ow'
presets.notes: Direction Down mirrors the sweep (Mu-Tron drive down switch)

presets.name: Chewy saturated filter
presets.desc: Signal pushed into a resonant band-pass: a thick, chewy, slightly growling envelope quack
presets.notes: Crate's chewy start (drive 12 dB, peak 8): saturation inside the filter, as when a Q-Tron is driven hard

presets.name: Talking vowel lead
presets.desc: Formant filter morphing a-e-i-o-u with picking strength: a talk-box-like vocal lead

refs.why: talk-box vowels that this formant filter imitates

presets.notes: Crate's talk-box start (Vowel, up, sensitivity 0.6); slower attack lets the vowel 'speak' rather than click

presets.name: Tempo-synced filter sweep
presets.desc: An LFO locked to quarter notes sweeps a resonant 4-pole low-pass: a pulsing synth-style filter
presets.notes: Crate's tempo-synced use; the LFO ignores playing dynamics, so it works on pads, loops and chords alike

presets.name: Random stepped filter
presets.desc: Sample-and-hold jumps the band-pass to a new random frequency every sixteenth note
presets.notes: Crate's random-stepped use: the classic synth S&H 'computer' burble, synced to the host

presets.name: Offbeat skank chirp
presets.desc: Fast high-pass envelope filter on offbeat chops: a thin, chirpy attack that stays out of the bass
presets.notes: High-pass sweeps up on each chop then relaxes: the skank chirps and leaves the low mids to the bass

presets.name: Breathing envelope wobble
presets.desc: Playing dynamics plus a slow LFO move the filter together: notes quack and then keep swaying
presets.notes: On electric piano: the LFO at 0.4 Hz keeps sustained chords moving after the envelope settles
